Cycling, strength training, outdoor running, and everyday activity were not tested. Temple, the wearable startup launched by Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal, has claimed that its temple-worn device measures heart rate more accurately than the Apple Watch Series 12, Fitbit Air, Whoop MG, Garmin Forerunner 970 and Oura Ring 5.The company made the claims in a study published on October 31.Temple funded, ran and analysed the study.
